observation: Static elevation placement dimensions were absent from interactive output that showed only component extents.
cause: Dimension observations were not classified and carried as structural relationship bindings into every consumer.
proposed_rule: Classify retained dimensions as size or relationship data, record omissions, and preserve stable subjects, structural endpoints, source evidence and measurement-specific uncertainty across consumers. Object size is not a substitute for placement or spacing.
limits: Focused source/consumer validation, not a fresh full-PDF audit, fabrication certification or approval of unresolved project measurements. Customer coordinates and dimension values remain project-local.
